title: No array, [] or [a, b]: when Effects run

slides.text: Three ways to end an Effect 🎛️
slides.say: The last argument of use effect decides when it runs. There are three versions.
No array at all: the Effect runs after every render.
An empty array: it runs only on mount, when the component appears.
With values: it runs on mount, and again whenever a or b changed since the last render.

slides.text: You don’t pick dependencies. Every reactive value the Effect reads must be listed.
slides.say: One catch: you don’t choose the list. Every reactive value the Effect reads must be in it, and the linter checks.
